question: How many surveys has team TEAM-X submitted?
interpretation: Conditional example: sum all five submission counters for active, non-deactivated team members. This is a per-team compliance metric, not a count of Survey rows.
sql:
SELECT t.TeamID,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.IsActive = 1 AND a.Deactivated IS NULL
         THEN c.NumDailySubmitted + c.NumWeeklySubmitted + c.NumMonthlySubmitted
              + c.BackgroundSubmitted + c.FinalSubmitted
         ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SurveyCount
FROM Team AS t
LEFT JOIN Compliance AS c ON c.TeamID = t.TeamID
LEFT JOIN Athlete AS a ON a.AthleteID = c.AthleteID
WHERE t.TeamID = %s
GROUP BY t.TeamID

question: How many athletes are enrolled in team TEAM-X?
interpretation: Conditional example: active Compliance membership and Athlete.Deactivated IS NULL.
sql:
SELECT t.TeamID,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.IsActive = 1 AND a.Deactivated IS NULL
         THEN a.AthleteID END) AS AthleteCount
FROM Team AS t
LEFT JOIN Compliance AS c ON c.TeamID = t.TeamID
LEFT JOIN Athlete AS a ON a.AthleteID = c.AthleteID
WHERE t.TeamID = %s
GROUP BY t.TeamID

question: How many surveys have been submitted in the last 7 days?
interpretation: All Survey rows in [reference minus 168 hours, reference); no membership or deactivation filter.
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS SurveyCount
FROM Survey
WHERE SubmissionDate >= %s AND SubmissionDate < %s

question: Who has submitted the most surveys?
interpretation: All-time counts of Survey rows for active, non-deactivated athletes; return AthleteID and all positive-count ties. Conditional on the population rule.
sql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT a.AthleteID, COUNT(s.SurveyID) AS SurveyCount
  FROM Athlete AS a
  LEFT JOIN Survey AS s ON s.AthleteID = a.AthleteID
  WHERE a.Deactivated IS NULL
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Compliance AS c
                WHERE c.AthleteID = a.AthleteID AND c.IsActive = 1)
  GROUP BY a.AthleteID
)
SELECT AthleteID, SurveyCount
FROM counts
WHERE SurveyCount > 0 AND SurveyCount = (SELECT MAX(SurveyCount) FROM counts)
ORDER BY AthleteID
LIMIT 100

question: Who hasn't submitted any surveys?
interpretation: Active, non-deactivated athletes with no Survey rows at any time. Conditional on the population rule.
sql:
SELECT a.AthleteID
FROM Athlete AS a
WHERE a.Deactivated IS NULL
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Compliance AS c
              WHERE c.AthleteID = a.AthleteID AND c.IsActive = 1)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Survey AS s WHERE s.AthleteID = a.AthleteID)
ORDER BY a.AthleteID
LIMIT 100
